title: Rename Connect button to Share for shared connections
line: In the Networks widget, saved hotspot connections now show a "Share" button instead of "Connect".
explanation: A saved Wi-Fi connection in access point mode starts a hotspot when activated, but the widget's default action button only looked at the connection state, so it always said "Connect" like for any other network. The model didn't tell QML whether an item was a hotspot. The change adds an IsHotspot role to NetworkModel (Wi-Fi connection in AP mode, refreshed when the mode changes) and the applet's button says "Share" for those while deactivated; "Disconnect" is unchanged.

commits.message:
applet: say "Share" instead of "Connect" for hotspot connections

Saved Wi-Fi connections in access point mode start a hotspot when they
are activated, but the widget labelled their button "Connect" just like
for normal networks. Expose whether an item is a hotspot and use "Share".

BUG: 423410

media.caption: Before (sweep tester, same master build): the hotspot profile "My Hotspot" shows "Connect" like the normal "Home" network.
After: "My Hotspot" shows "Share"; "Home" and the scanned "HotAP" network still show "Connect".
